camel_example: aliyun emr IncreaseNodes --region cn-hangzhou --IncreaseNodeCount 3 --AutoPayOrder false --MinIncreaseNodeCount 1 --ClusterId 'c-b933c5aac8fe0000' --NodeGroupId 'ng-869471354ecd0000' --AutoRenew false --PaymentDurationUnit Month --Promotions.1 'example-string' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PaymentDuration 12 --ApplicationConfigs.1 'example-string' --method POST --force
description_en: Scales out a target node group
description_zh: 对目标节点组执行扩容操作
kebab_example: aliyun emr increase-nodes --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c-b933c5aac8fe0000 --node-group-id ng-869471354ecd0000 --increase-node-count 3 --auto-pay-order false --auto-renew false --payment-duration 12 --payment-duration-unit Month --application-configs example-string --min-increase-node-count 1 --promotions example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: IncreaseNodes

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node group to scale out
parameters.help_zh: 节点组ID。扩容的目标节点组
parameters.name: node_group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of nodes to add. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 节点数量。本次扩容的增量节点数量。取值范围：1~500
parameters.name: increase_node_count

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically pay for the order. This parameter is effective only when the PaymentType of the node group is Subscription. Valid values:

true: Automatically pays for the order.

false: Does not automatically pay for the order.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付本次扩容操作涉及的订单。节点组付费类型PaymentType取值Subscription时该参数生效。取值范围：
true：自动支付本次操作涉及的订单。
false：不自动支付本次操作涉及的订单。

默认值：false
parameters.name: auto_pay_order

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the added nodes. The default value is false. Valid values:

true: Enables auto-renewal.

false: Disables auto-renewal
parameters.help_zh:
本次扩容的节点是否开启自动续费，默认值为false。取值范围：
true：开启自动续费。
false：不开启自动续费
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en: The subscription duration. If PaymentDurationUnit is set to Month, valid values are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, 36, 48, and 60
parameters.name: payment_duration

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:

Month: The unit is month
parameters.help_zh:
付费时长单位。取值范围：
Month：月
parameters.name: payment_duration_unit

fields.help_en: The name of the application. You can view the application names of each EMR version on the cluster creation page in the EMR console
fields.help_zh: 应用名称。从EMR控制台集群创建页面可查看到各EMR发行版的应用名称列表
fields.name: application_name

fields.help_en: The name of the configuration file
fields.name: config_file_name

fields.help_en: The key of the configuration item
fields.name: config_item_key

fields.help_en: The value of the configuration item
fields.name: config_item_value

fields.help_en:
The level at which you want to apply the configurations. Valid values:

CLUSTER
NODE_GROUP

Default value: CLUSTER
fields.help_zh:
配置范围。取值范围：
CLUSTER：集群级别。
NODE_GROUP：节点组级别。

默认值：CLUSTER
fields.name: config_scope

fields.help_en: The node group ID. This parameter takes effect only when the ConfigScope parameter is set to NODE_GROUP. The NodeGroupId parameter has a higher priority than the NodeGroupName parameter
fields.help_zh: 节点组ID。ConfigScope取值NODE_GROUP时，该参数生效。NodeGroupId参数优先级高于NodeGroupName
fields.name: node_group_id

fields.help_en: The name of the node group. This parameter takes effect only when the ConfigScope parameter is set to NODE_GROUP and the NodeGroupId parameter is not configured
fields.help_zh: 节点组名称。ConfigScope取值NODE_GROUP时，且参数NodeGroupId为空时生效，该参数生效
fields.name: node_group_name

parameters.help_en: The application configurations. The number of array elements can range from 1 to 1,000
parameters.help_zh: 应用配置。数组元素个数N的取值范围：1~1000
parameters.name: application_configs

parameters.help_en:
The minimum number of nodes to add in this scale-out operation. The value must be between 1 and 500.

If you set this parameter and the available ECS inventory is less than IncreaseNodeCount, the system attempts to create at least the number of nodes specified by MinIncreaseNodeCount. The scale-out flow is then marked as `PARTIAL_COMPLETED`.

If you do not set this parameter and the available ECS inventory is less than IncreaseNodeCount, the scale-out flow fails and is marked as `FAILED`
parameters.help_zh:
本次扩容接受的最小节点数量。取值范围为 1 到 500。

若设置了该值，当ECS库存数量小于IncreaseNodeCount 时，扩容流程将尽力创建 `MinIncreaseNodeCount` 个节点，扩容流程状态将显示为部分成功 `PARTIAL_COMPLETED`。
如果不设置该值，当ECS库存数量小于IncreaseNodeCount 时，扩容流程失败，状态为失败 `FAILED`
parameters.name: min_increase_node_count
